requirements: R1: Address the specification coverage gap for the educational knowledge base by integrating existing document storage, search, RBAC, and regulatory features

slices.title: Patch existing knowledge base features
slices.jtbd: When implementing the knowledge base patch for this epic, I want to wire the existing storage, search, and RBAC components, so that the 9-section client specification is correctly fulfilled.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given the existing knowledge base components,
When a user accesses document storage and search,
Then the RBAC and regulatory features are enforced and tested appropriately.
slices.sixSigmaMetric: Achieve 100% test coverage for RBAC document retrieval paths

epics.title: Systemic Planning Integrity and ECHO Coherence
epics.jtbd: When the system evaluates and generates task plans, I want it to strictly enforce TOC bottlenecks, accurately report coverage, and use Explanatory Coherence (ECHO), so that falsified success reports and duplicate tasks are eliminated.
epics.sixSigmaMetric: Reduce system-wide falsified audit generation to 0 incidents
requirements: R1: Prevent coverage-audit.json from returning empty gaps when specifications are unmet
R2: Prevent task-plan.json from faking coverageComplete=true without actual validation
R3: Enforce strict TOC constraints in task plans and reject qualitative descriptive phrases
R4: Integrate Explanatory Coherence (ECHO) evaluation to halt duplicate isolated PR generation

slices.title: Patch planning validation and ECHO integration
slices.jtbd: When implementing the planning patch for this epic, I want to enforce strict coverage and TOC validation and integrate ECHO, so that falsified plan generation is blocked.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given the technical lead compiler,
When a task plan is generated,
Then coverage and TOC constraints are strictly validated and ECHO evaluation halts duplicate plans.
slices.sixSigmaMetric: Reduce invalid TechnicalLeadCompiler constraint passes to 0%

slices.title: Verify planning integrity and ECHO prevention
slices.jtbd: When testing the planning patch for this epic, I want to execute unit and integration tests against the compiler, so that falsification prevention and ECHO duplicate halting are verified.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given the patched technical lead compiler,
When automated tests trigger coverage audits and duplicate plan scenarios,
Then the tests assert that falsified reports are blocked and duplicate plans are halted.
slices.sixSigmaMetric: Achieve 100% test pass rate for planning validation rules

requirements: R1: Revert unmerged closed PR internal tasks to failed status instead of retaining the old status
R2: Correct the testSyncTaskStatusesDoesNotPerformRedundantUpdatesOnSubsequentRuns test to assert the actual status reversion

slices.title: Patch PR closed sync logic and tests
slices.jtbd: When implementing the PR sync patch for this epic, I want to update the logic to revert unmerged closed PR tasks to failed and fix the corresponding tests, so that the task status accurately reflects GitHub state.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given a task linked to an unmerged closed PR,
When the sync process runs,
Then the internal task status is reverted to failed and verified by automated tests.
slices.sixSigmaMetric: Reduce false positive done statuses in PR sync to 0%

epics.title: Prevent Falsified Success Reports in Audits and Plans

epics.sixSigmaMetric: Reduce falsified code integrity audit records to 0 incidents
requirements: R1: Stop generation of falsified coverage-audit.json and task-plan.json by enforcing specification validation and root-cause repair checks
